why: Small tests-step follow-up of anti-slop judgment slice AS-no-manual-tagged-construction-4 (ticket 1057), on branch fabrikalfa/antislop-no-manual-tagged-construction-4 from the build's head 44d8fff19. The build removed the hand-written RetriesExhausted tag in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/chain.ts, which left one stale agents-ledger.json entry; agents-ledger.json is an exam path, so the build could not commit it. This step pruned it the repo's way: node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts, the lint part that rewrites the ledgers, said 'agents-ledger.json: pruned 1 fixed entries; commit the file'. The diff is exactly that one entry (file .agents/skills/lead/scripts/chain.ts, rule fabrika(no-hand-tag), code '_tag: "RetriesExhausted" as const,'), 5 lines removed and nothing else; a pnpm format run after it left the diff the same. The ledger only shrinks; nothing was added. No law written or changed, no product file touched, no .oxlintrc.json line and no lock line.
note: No test file changed, so no vitest ran. pnpm lint (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144) passes 17 of its 18 parts and no longer asks for the ledger commit; the red part is oxlint-plugins/lint.ts, which only asks that five folders now at zero (.agents, next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes, schedules and transport, next/programs/inbox) join the rule's block in .oxlintrc.json, the later lock pull request's job. The list ratchet (next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/ratchet.ts --base 5c94f12f4) exits 0 and reads agents-ledger.json as done.
